# NaufalRF Public Portfolio — Full LLM Context

## Overview

This Astro app is the main public-facing portfolio for NaufalRF. It presents portfolio content, writing, biography, booking/contact entrypoints, guestbook interactions, and the public AI assistant UI. It is intentionally a read/proxy consumer of Admin APIs rather than a database-backed authority.

## Core responsibilities

- Render project discovery, about/profile content, writing/mentions, contact/booking, and guestbook surfaces.
- Keep SEO metadata, structured data, canonical URLs, robots, and sitemap outputs accurate.
- Provide the main AI assistant user interface and route browser chat traffic through same-origin Astro API proxies.
- Keep social/profile rendering aligned with Admin-managed `profile_links` while excluding generic website links from the public social surfaces.

## Architecture

- Framework: Astro 5 with React islands.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4 with a CSS-first `@theme` setup and a light-neumorphic component vocabulary.
- Data source: Admin public APIs via `src/lib/api.ts`.
- Chat boundary: browser -> `src/pages/api/rag/chat.ts` -> RAG service.
- Contact/booking boundary: browser -> local Astro API routes -> Admin public APIs.

## Important routes and components

- `src/pages/index.astro` — homepage composition and structured data.
- `src/pages/about.astro` + `src/components/about/AboutContent.tsx` — biography, achievements, experience, skills.
- `src/pages/projects/index.astro` — projects discovery.
- `src/pages/blogs.astro` — writing and mentions.
- `src/pages/contact.astro` + `src/components/contact/*` — inquiries and booking UI.
- `src/pages/guestbook.astro` + `src/components/home/Guestbook.tsx` — guestbook page and homepage preview mode.
- `src/pages/ai-chatbot.astro` + `src/components/chatbot/*` — public AI assistant shell, chat window, markdown rendering, persistence.
- `src/components/layout/Navbar.astro` and `src/layouts/PageLayout.astro` — public navigation shell and mobile bottom nav behavior.

## Chat behavior

- Chat history persists in browser `localStorage` and can be reset from the chat header.
- Desktop uses the floating widget; mobile redirects to the dedicated `/ai-chatbot` page.
- Markdown is rendered safely with `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm`, and `rehype-sanitize`.
- Route suggestions are compact follow-up links, not citation-heavy answer cards.

## Guestbook behavior

- Homepage uses compact preview mode.
- Dedicated `/guestbook` renders full messages without repeating the page hero copy inside the component.
- CTA placement changes with auth state: signed-out users see sign-in plus guestbook route access together; signed-in users see leave-message plus guestbook route access together.

## Constraints

- Never bypass Admin APIs for content or storage.
- Keep public social displays limited to actual social/profile platforms.
- Preserve the public SEO/discoverability surface when editing routes.
- Treat this app as the main narrative/public UX surface for the portfolio ecosystem.
